'''Tarka-Null''' was a famous [[Sculptor/Legends|sculptor]]. [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] had one of [[Gender/Legends|his]] originals in her [[Naboo Queen (restaurant)|apartment]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
